findings.title: 200ms bus lock cap is leaky: telemetry shows hook lock-waits up to 2293ms (11x the cap) and 23 successful writes acquired after >200ms — acquireLockSync only checks the deadline on one branch, after blocking syscalls, and never on the success path

evidence.quote:
* Default bus lock-wait cap (WS-2 Phase B.0). A per-tool bus write waits at most
 * this long for the lock before it is treated as a DROPPED write (logged, never
 * silent) -- far below atomic-write's 5s default so the hook can never hang on a
{"bus_id":"s-mq2d1mqj-8d40fb04dee1","query_type":"bus_write_dropped","reason":"lock_timeout","wait_ms":2293,"duration_ms":2293,"ts":"2026-06-07T05:34:38.068Z","schema_version":1}

findings.observe_how: Mechanism: in acquireLockSync the timeout comparison lives ONLY inside the EEXIST+fresh-lock branch (atomic-write.ts:93) — the stale-removal continue (:85), the stat-throw continue (:89), and the openSync-success return (:72-76) never check elapsed time, and each loop iteration's openSync/statSync syscalls (slow under Defender) are not budgeted before the first check. Empirically: bus_write_dropped rows cluster at wait_ms 639-714 with a 2293 max, and 23 SUCCESSFUL bus_write rows record wait_ms>200 (lock acquired after the supposed deadline). Additionally write_ms (atomicWriteSync inside the lock) is unbounded — max recorded 2362ms — so worst-case PostToolUse hook stall is wait+write, multi-second, on the every-Read/Grep/Edit hot path.

findings.title: intel-bus redaction escapes: quoted secret values containing spaces leak their tail, and common key shapes (Google AIza..., github_pat_..., glpat-..., Azure AccountKey=, PASSPHRASE=) pass both the shape pass and the keyword pass

evidence.quote:
const SECRET_KEY_RE =
  /API_?KEY|SECRET|TOKEN|PASSWORD|PASSWD|DATABASE_URL|CONNECTION_?STRING|ACCESS_?KEY|PRIVATE_?KEY|AUTHORIZATION|CREDENTIAL/i;

.replace(/sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,512}/g, 'sk-[REDACTED]') // OpenAI
    .replace(/AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}/g, '[REDACTED-AWS-KEY]') // AWS access key id
    .replace(/gh[posru]_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,255}/g, '[REDACTED-GH-TOKEN]') // GitHub
    .replace(/xox[abprs]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{10,512}/gi, '[REDACTED-SLACK-TOKEN]') // Slack

findings.observe_how: Concrete escapes from reading the regexes: (1) PASSWORD="my secret pass" — ASSIGNMENT_RE value class [^\s]{1,2048} stops at the first space, redacting only `"my` and leaving `secret pass"` in clear; (2) bare Google API keys (AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{35}) match no standalone shape; (3) GitHub fine-grained github_pat_... is not covered by gh[posru]_; (4) GitLab glpat-... absent; (5) Azure storage `AccountKey=...` — 'AccountKey' matches neither SECRET_KEY_RE nor the anchored SECRET_FIELD_NAME_RE (no bare KEY alternative); (6) PASSPHRASE= matches no keyword. Defense-in-depth context: events are allowlist-constructed, so exposure requires a free-text field (e.g. a focus term or future caller) carrying one of these shapes.
findings.telemetry: no leaked-secret rows observed in the live log; gap is latent
causal_links: D4a-06 (the duplicated mjs appender has NO redaction at all, widening this gap for any future free-text field)

coverage_manifest: context-bus.ts (atomic RMW, revision CAS, transient-failure no-clobber): CLEAN on correctness — read->apply->write happens under one lock hold via mutateStateWithLock; ENOENT vs unreadable/corrupt correctly distinguished (loadState 'failed' -> no-op, never clobbered); injected-write CAS branch is test-only; busPath traversal containment with trailing-sep check verified. Defect found in the LOCK-WAIT bound, not the RMW (D4a-02).

context-bus.ts 200ms cap / bus_write_dropped: DEFECT — cap empirically leaky (waits to 2293ms, 23 successful acquires past deadline, write_ms unbounded to 2362ms); drop logging itself is correct and never-silent, including the acquired-but-not-persisted 'write_error' path (D4a-02).

session-bus-id.ts: CLEAN — sanitizeBusPart collapses dot-runs (no '..' survivor), project hash is realpath+lowercase sha256 (not inode), getBusId never throws; intentionally a second id scheme per finding #15 (consolidation deferral already seeded as SEED-12).

intel-bus.ts redaction: GAPS — quoted-value-with-spaces tail leak via ASSIGNMENT_RE [^\s] value class; missing shapes AIza/github_pat_/glpat-/AccountKey=/PASSPHRASE (D4a-04). Bearer-before-assignment ordering, JWT/AWS/Slack/postgres shapes, field-name wholesale redaction, and array keyHint inheritance all verified present.
intel-bus.ts 4KB cap: CLEAN — truncate-largest-field then drop, never a partial line; deep CR/LF strip keeps one event per line.

intel-bus.ts rotation: MOSTLY CLEAN — single-generation .1 rename with documented accepted concurrent-writer race; prune IS wired via session-start-intel-prune.ts (SessionStart, registered in active settings.json); dead '.2' prune branch (D4a-08); duplicate rotator in code-intel.mjs races the same file (D4a-06).

atomic-write.ts: DEFECT in acquireLockSync timeout placement (D4a-02); atomicWriteSync temp+rename correct; mutateStateWithLock transient-read/throwing-transform/null-transform no-op semantics verified correct; note (not filed): stale-lock removal has a small TOCTOU window where two waiters can both unlink/recreate, and the 50ms busy-wait is a synchronous CPU spin.

bus-session-populator.ts: CLEAN structurally (writer-only, no context injection, sanitized 120-char intent, skip-guards mirror memory-awareness so turn counter stays in lock-step); inherits SEED-13 intent pollution (D4a-09).

bus-tool-populator.ts: path hygiene VERIFIED strong (realpath both sides, isAbsolute+'..' escape rejection for UNC/cross-volume, noise segments, dedup+caps); DEFECT-adjacent: ambient grep_hit slice has no behavioral consumer while costing a lock+full-rewrite per Grep (D4a-05).

Single-writer rule repo-wide: HOLDS — grep for context.json writers found only context-bus.ts mutateBus callers, all hooks (bus-session-populator UserPromptSubmit, bus-tool-populator PostToolUse Read|Grep, post-edit-diagnostics PostToolUse Edit, all registered in active settings.json); scripts/code-intel.mjs `bus` subcommand is read-only (its writeFileSync targets .codegraph/.indexed-head); shared/spec-context.ts writes .claude/cache/spec-context.json, a different file outside the session bus root.

Staleness suppression: HOLDS — bus-focus.ts isFresh window [-1, BUS_STALENESS_MAX_AGE=3], missing/non-numeric turn_added treated as stale, far-future turn_added rejected; readers cap scans at 200 and allowlist-sanitize every term before argv/injection.

FIFO caps: HOLD — 50-caps enforced both in add* helpers and at the coerceBus read choke point (so a bloated legacy file cannot persist through bumpTurn/setIntent); load_bearing evicts oldest turn with (path,role) dedup; ambient bounded by 30% ratio + floor 3 on write and by a hard 50 ceiling on coerce.

corr-null 60.7% root cause: FOUND — hook emitters never set correlation_id, backfill hardcodes null, and the facade's per-invocation randomUUID appears in exactly one row with parent_event_id never populated, so correlation is structurally impossible today (D4a-01).
notes: All findings VERIFIED by reading src (never dist) plus read-only counts on the live .claude/logs/intel-bus.jsonl (647 rows at review time; the harvest snapshot had 318 — ratios shifted but the corr-null mechanism is identical). The .claude/logs/intel-bus.jsonl evidence rows are append-only and were at line 435 (wait_ms 2293) at review time; if rotation occurs before verification, the same rows exist in docs/reviews/2026-06-10/harvest/snapshot/intel-bus.jsonl (excluded dir — cite only for cross-check, the live file is the citable source). Not filed as findings (below bar or accepted-by-design, recorded here for the verifier): acquireLockSync stale-lock TOCTOU double-unlink window (requires a 10s-stale lock; temp+rename prevents corruption, only a lost update possible), the 50ms synchronous busy-wait CPU spin, and coerceFilesInPlay bounding ambient at LOAD_BEARING_CAP rather than re-enforcing the 30% ratio on read (bound-only, readers ignore ambient anyway).
